                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"
                    ]
                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"
                    ]
                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to.                     "description": "(x, y): The end coordinates for `drag_and_drop`. Required only by `drag_and_drop`.",
                    "type": "array"

                "direction": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=scroll or action_type=swipe.",
                    "enum": [
                        "up",
                        "down",
                        "left",
                        "right"

}

Output EXACTLY in this format:
Thought: Reasoning about what to do next.

prompt.content:

Choose exactly ONE action and output it as a tool call.

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "mobile_use",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "action_type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"
                    ]
                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"
                    ]
                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to. Required only by `action=click`, `action=double_tap`, `action=long_press`, `action_type=input_text`, and `action=drag_and_drop`. Optional for `action=swipe`.",
                    "type": "array"

                    "description": "(x, y): The end coordinates for `drag_and_drop`. Required only by `drag_and_drop`.",
                    "type": "array"

                "direction": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=scroll or action_type=swipe.",
                    "enum": [
                        "up",
                        "down",
                        "left",
                        "right"
                    ]
                },
                "app_name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=open_app."
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "action_type"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
        }
    }
}
</tools>

{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}

* This is an interface to a mobile device with touchscreen. You can perform actions like clicking, typing, swiping, etc.
* Some applications may take time to start or process actions, so you may need to wait and take successive screenshots to see the results of your actions.
* The screen's resolution is 1000 x 1000.
* Make sure to click any buttons, links, icons, etc with the cursor tip in the center of the element. Don't click boxes on their edges unless asked.

Choose exactly ONE action and output it as a tool call.

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "mobile_use",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "action_type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"
                    ]
                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"
                    ]
                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to. Required only by `action=click`, `action=double_tap`, `action=long_press`, `action_type=input_text`, and `action=drag_and_drop`. Optional for `action=swipe`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "coordinate2": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The end coordinates for `drag_and_drop`. Required only by `drag_and_drop`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "direction": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=scroll or action_type=swipe.",
                    "enum": [
                        "up",
                        "down",
                        "left",
                        "right"
                    ]
                },
                "app_name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=open_app."
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "action_type"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
        }
    }
}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

# Response format

Response format for every step:
1) Thought: one concise sentence explaining the next move (no multi-step reasoning).
2) Action: a short imperative describing what to do in the UI.
3) A single <tool_call>...</tool_call> block containing only the JSON: {"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}.

Rules:
- Do NOT use the app drawer. ALWAYS use `open_app` to open applications. `open_app` MUST include `app_name`.
- Use `input_text` for typing. `input_text` MUST include `coordinate` and `text`.
- `click`, `double_tap`, `long_press` MUST include `coordinate`.
- `swipe` is for directional gestures. `coordinate` is optional; if provided, swipes from that point. MUST include `direction`.
- `drag_and_drop` MUST include `coordinate` (start) and `coordinate2` (end).
- Use `scroll` for page navigation (e.g., `down` reveals content below). `scroll` MUST include `direction`. Do NOT provide `coordinate`.
- `answer` MUST include `text`.
- `status` MUST include `goal_status`.
- (x,y) are screenshot pixels; keep within bounds.
- If you need info to answer, navigate, then `answer`, then `status` complete.
- If stuck after retries, try a different approach.
- Output exactly in the order: Thought, Action, <tool_call>.
- Be brief: one sentence for Thought, one for Action.
- Do not output anything else outside those three parts.
- If finishing successfully, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"complete"}.
- If the task is infeasible, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"infeasible"}.

* This is an interface to a mobile device with touchscreen. You can perform actions like clicking, typing, swiping, etc.
* Some applications may take time to start or process actions, so you may need to wait and take successive screenshots to see the results of your actions.
* The screen's resolution is 1000 x 1000.
* Make sure to click any buttons, links, icons, etc with the cursor tip in the center of the element. Don't click boxes on their edges unless asked.

Choose exactly ONE action and output it as a tool call.

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "mobile_use",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "action_type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"
                    ]
                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"
                    ]
                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to. Required only by `action=click`, `action=double_tap`, `action=long_press`, `action_type=input_text`, and `action=drag_and_drop`. Optional for `action=swipe`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "coordinate2": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The end coordinates for `drag_and_drop`. Required only by `drag_and_drop`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "direction": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=scroll or action_type=swipe.",
                    "enum": [
                        "up",
                        "down",
                        "left",
                        "right"
                    ]
                },
                "app_name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=open_app."
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "action_type"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
        }
    }
}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

# Response format

Response format for every step:
1) Thought: one concise sentence explaining the next move (no multi-step reasoning).
2) Action: a short imperative describing what to do in the UI.
3) A single <tool_call>...</tool_call> block containing only the JSON: {"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}.

Rules:
- Do NOT use the app drawer. ALWAYS use `open_app` to open applications. `open_app` MUST include `app_name`.
- Use `input_text` for typing. `input_text` MUST include `coordinate` and `text`.
- `click`, `double_tap`, `long_press` MUST include `coordinate`.
- `swipe` is for directional gestures. `coordinate` is optional; if provided, swipes from that point. MUST include `direction`.
- `drag_and_drop` MUST include `coordinate` (start) and `coordinate2` (end).
- Use `scroll` for page navigation (e.g., `down` reveals content below). `scroll` MUST include `direction`. Do NOT provide `coordinate`.
- `answer` MUST include `text`.
- `status` MUST include `goal_status`.
- (x,y) are screenshot pixels; keep within bounds.
- If you need info to answer, navigate, then `answer`, then `status` complete.
- If stuck after retries, try a different approach.
- Output exactly in the order: Thought, Action, <tool_call>.
- Be brief: one sentence for Thought, one for Action.
- Do not output anything else outside those three parts.
- If finishing successfully, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"complete"}.
- If the task is infeasible, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"infeasible"}.

Goal: Add the following songs, in order, Through the Storm, Hidden Paths, Forever Young, Whispers of the Past, Heartbeat Away to my playing queue in Retro music.

History: Step 1: Swipe up from the bottom of the screen to the top.
Step 2: Scroll down to view more apps on the screen.
Step 3: Click on the "Retro Music" app icon to open it.
Step 4: Click the search icon at the top left corner of the screen.
Step 5: Type "Through the Storm" into the search bar.
Step 6: Click on the three-dot menu next to the song "Through the Storm" to open the options menu.
Step 7: Click on the "Play next" option in the menu to add the song to the playback queue.
Step 8: Click the 'X' icon next to the search bar to clear the search input.
Step 9: Type "Hidden Paths" into the search bar.
Step 10: Click on the three-dot menu next to the song "Hidden Paths" to open the options menu.
Step 11: Click on the "Add to playlist" option in the menu.
Step 12: Click the "X" icon at the top right to clear the current search.
Step 13: Type "Forever Young" into the search bar.
Step 14: Click on the three-dot menu next to the song "Forever Young" to open the options menu.
Step 15: Click on the "Add to playlist" option in the menu.
Step 16: Click the 'X' icon in the search bar to clear the search query.
Step 17: Type "Whispers of the Past" into the search bar.
Step 18: Click on the three-dot menu next to the song "Whispers of the Past" to open the options menu.
Step 19: Click on the song "Whispers of the Past" to select it.
Step 20: Click the 'X' icon next to the search bar to clear the current search query.
Step 21: Type "Heartbeat Away" into the search bar.

Output EXACTLY in this format:
Thought: Reasoning about what to do next.
Action: A short natural-language description of what you did.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mobile_use", "arguments": {"action_type": ...}}
</tool_call>

* This is an interface to a mobile device with touchscreen. You can perform actions like clicking, typing, swiping, etc.
* Some applications may take time to start or process actions, so you may need to wait and take successive screenshots to see the results of your actions.
* The screen's resolution is 1000 x 1000.
* Make sure to click any buttons, links, icons, etc with the cursor tip in the center of the element. Don't click boxes on their edges unless asked.

Choose exactly ONE action and output it as a tool call.

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "mobile_use",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "action_type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"
                    ]
                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"
                    ]
                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to. Required only by `action=click`, `action=double_tap`, `action=long_press`, `action_type=input_text`, and `action=drag_and_drop`. Optional for `action=swipe`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "coordinate2": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The end coordinates for `drag_and_drop`. Required only by `drag_and_drop`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "direction": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=scroll or action_type=swipe.",
                    "enum": [
                        "up",
                        "down",
                        "left",
                        "right"
                    ]
                },
                "app_name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=open_app."
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "action_type"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
        }
    }
}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

# Response format

Response format for every step:
1) Thought: one concise sentence explaining the next move (no multi-step reasoning).
2) Action: a short imperative describing what to do in the UI.
3) A single <tool_call>...</tool_call> block containing only the JSON: {"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}.

Rules:
- Do NOT use the app drawer. ALWAYS use `open_app` to open applications. `open_app` MUST include `app_name`.
- Use `input_text` for typing. `input_text` MUST include `coordinate` and `text`.
- `click`, `double_tap`, `long_press` MUST include `coordinate`.
- `swipe` is for directional gestures. `coordinate` is optional; if provided, swipes from that point. MUST include `direction`.
- `drag_and_drop` MUST include `coordinate` (start) and `coordinate2` (end).
- Use `scroll` for page navigation (e.g., `down` reveals content below). `scroll` MUST include `direction`. Do NOT provide `coordinate`.
- `answer` MUST include `text`.
- `status` MUST include `goal_status`.
- (x,y) are screenshot pixels; keep within bounds.
- If you need info to answer, navigate, then `answer`, then `status` complete.
- If stuck after retries, try a different approach.
- Output exactly in the order: Thought, Action, <tool_call>.
- Be brief: one sentence for Thought, one for Action.
- Do not output anything else outside those three parts.
- If finishing successfully, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"complete"}.
- If the task is infeasible, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"infeasible"}.

History: Step 1: Open the Simple Gallery Pro app.

Output EXACTLY in this format:
Thought: Reasoning about what to do next.
Action: A short natural-language description of what you did.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mobile_use", "arguments": {"action_type": ...}}
</tool_call>

                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"

                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"

                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to.                     "type": "array"

                    "type": "string",

- If you need info to answer, navigate, then `answer`, then `status` complete.
- If stuck after retries, try a different approach.

- Do not output anything else outside those three parts.

                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"
                    ]
                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"
                    ]
                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to. Required only by `action=click`, `action=double_tap`, `action=long_press`, `action_type=input_text`, and `action=drag_and_drop`. Optional for `action=swipe`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "coordinate2": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The end coordinates for `drag_and_drop`. Required only by `drag_and_drop`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "direction": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=scroll or action_type=swipe.",
                    "enum": [
                        "up",
                        "down",
                        "left",
                        "right"
                    ]
                },
                "app_name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=open_app."
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "action_type"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
        }
    }
}
</tools>

<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

Step 2: Click on the "Settings" app icon.
Step 3: Click on "Connected devices" in the settings menu.
Step 4: Click on "Connection preferences" to access the list of connection options.
Step 5: Click on the "Bluetooth" option to access the Bluetooth settings.

prompt.content:
You are a helpful and precise assistant for answering questions about mobile devices. Use a touchscreen to interact with a mobile device, and take screenshots.
* This is an interface to a mobile device with touchscreen. You can perform actions like clicking, typing, swiping, etc.
* Some applications may take time to start or process actions, so you may need to wait and take successive screenshots to see the results of your actions.
* The screen's resolution is 1000 x 1000.
* Make sure to click any buttons, links, icons, etc with the cursor tip in the center of the element. Don't click boxes on their edges unless asked.

Choose exactly ONE action and output it as a tool call.

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "mobile_use",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "action_type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"
                    ]
                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"
                    ]
                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to. Required only by `action=click`, `action=double_tap`, `action=long_press`, `action_type=input_text`, and `action=drag_and_drop`. Optional for `action=swipe`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "coordinate2": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The end coordinates for `drag_and_drop`. Required only by `drag_and_drop`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "direction": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=scroll or action_type=swipe.",
                    "enum": [
                        "up",
                        "down",
                        "left",
                        "right"
                    ]
                },
                "app_name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=open_app."
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "action_type"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
        }
    }
}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

# Response format

Response format for every step:
1) Thought: one concise sentence explaining the next move (no multi-step reasoning).
2) Action: a short imperative describing what to do in the UI.
3) A single <tool_call>...</tool_call> block containing only the JSON: {"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}.

Rules:
- Do NOT use the app drawer. ALWAYS use `open_app` to open applications. `open_app` MUST include `app_name`.
- Use `input_text` for typing. `input_text` MUST include `coordinate` and `text`.
- `click`, `double_tap`, `long_press` MUST include `coordinate`.
- `swipe` is for directional gestures. `coordinate` is optional; if provided, swipes from that point. MUST include `direction`.
- `drag_and_drop` MUST include `coordinate` (start) and `coordinate2` (end).
- Use `scroll` for page navigation (e.g., `down` reveals content below). `scroll` MUST include `direction`. Do NOT provide `coordinate`.
- `answer` MUST include `text`.
- `status` MUST include `goal_status`.
- (x,y) are screenshot pixels; keep within bounds.
- If you need info to answer, navigate, then `answer`, then `status` complete.
- If stuck after retries, try a different approach.
- Output exactly in the order: Thought, Action, <tool_call>.
- Be brief: one sentence for Thought, one for Action.
- Do not output anything else outside those three parts.
- If finishing successfully, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"complete"}.
- If the task is infeasible, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"infeasible"}.

Step 2: Click on the "Settings" app icon.
Step 3: Click on "Connected devices" in the settings menu.
Step 4: Click on "Connection preferences" to access the list of connection options.
Step 5: Click on the "Bluetooth" option to access the Bluetooth settings.
Step 6: Click the toggle switch next to "Use Bluetooth" to turn Bluetooth off.

Output EXACTLY in this format:
Thought: Reasoning about what to do next.
Action: A short natural-language description of what you did.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mobile_use", "arguments": {"action_type": ...}}

1) Thought: one concise sentence explaining the next move (no multi-step reasoning).
2) Action: a short imperative describing what to do in the UI.
3) A single <tool_call>...</tool_call> block containing only the JSON: {"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}.

Rules:
- Do NOT use the app drawer. ALWAYS use `open_app` to open applications. `open_app` MUST include `app_name`.
- Use `input_text` for typing. `input_text` MUST include `coordinate` and `text`.
- `click`, `double_tap`, `long_press` MUST include `coordinate`.
- `swipe` is for directional gestures. `coordinate` is optional; if provided, swipes from that point. MUST include `direction`.
- `drag_and_drop` MUST include `coordinate` (start) and `coordinate2` (end).
- Use `scroll` for page navigation (e.g., `down` reveals content below). `scroll` MUST include `direction`. Do NOT provide `coordinate`.
- `answer` MUST include `text`.
- `status` MUST include `goal_status`.
- (x,y) are screenshot pixels; keep within bounds.
- If you need info to answer, navigate, then `answer`, then `status` complete.
- If stuck after retries, try a different approach.
- Output exactly in the order: Thought, Action, <tool_call>.
- Be brief: one sentence for Thought, one for Action.
- Do not output anything else outside those three parts.
- If finishing successfully, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"complete"}.
- If the task is infeasible, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"infeasible"}.

1) Thought: one concise sentence explaining the next move (no multi-step reasoning).
2) Action: a short imperative describing what to do in the UI.
3) A single <tool_call>...</tool_call> block containing only the JSON: {"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}.

Rules:
- Do NOT use the app drawer. ALWAYS use `open_app` to open applications. `open_app` MUST include `app_name`.
- Use `input_text` for typing. `input_text` MUST include `coordinate` and `text`.
- `click`, `double_tap`, `long_press` MUST include `coordinate`.
- `swipe` is for directional gestures. `coordinate` is optional; if provided, swipes from that point. MUST include `direction`.
- `drag_and_drop` MUST include `coordinate` (start) and `coordinate2` (end).
- Use `scroll` for page navigation (e.g., `down` reveals content below). `scroll` MUST include `direction`. Do NOT provide `coordinate`.
- `answer` MUST include `text`.
- `status` MUST include `goal_status`.
- (x,y) are screenshot pixels; keep within bounds.
- If you need info to answer, navigate, then `answer`, then `status` complete.
- If stuck after retries, try a different approach.
- Output exactly in the order: Thought, Action, <tool_call>.
- Be brief: one sentence for Thought, one for Action.
- Do not output anything else outside those three parts.
- If finishing successfully, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"complete"}.
- If the task is infeasible, the tool_call arguments MUST be {"action_type":"status","goal_status":"infeasible"}.

Goal: Turn brightness to the min value.

History: Step 1: Click on the "Settings" icon to open the settings menu.
Step 2: Scroll down to view more settings options.
Step 3: Type "brightness" into the search bar.

Output EXACTLY in this format:
Thought: Reasoning about what to do next.
Action: A short natural-language description of what you did.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mobile_use", "arguments": {"action_type": ...}}
</tool_call>

prompt.content:
You are a helpful and precise assistant for answering questions about mobile devices. Use a touchscreen to interact with a mobile device, and take screenshots.
* This is an interface to a mobile device with touchscreen. You can perform actions like clicking, typing, swiping, etc.
* Some applications may take time to start or process actions, so you may need to wait and take successive screenshots to see the results of your actions.
* The screen's resolution is 1000 x 1000.
* Make sure to click any buttons, links, icons, etc with the cursor tip in the center of the element. Don't click boxes on their edges unless asked.

Choose exactly ONE action and output it as a tool call.

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "mobile_use",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "action_type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The action to perform.",
                    "enum": [
                        "status",
                        "answer",
                        "click",
                        "double_tap",
                        "long_press",
                        "input_text",
                        "keyboard_enter",
                        "navigate_home",
                        "navigate_back",
                        "scroll",
                        "swipe",
                        "open_app",
                        "wait",
                        "drag_and_drop"
                    ]
                },
                "goal_status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=status.",
                    "enum": [
                        "complete",
                        "infeasible"
                    ]
                },
                "text": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=answer or action_type=input_text."
                },
                "coordinate": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates to move the mouse to. Required only by `action=click`, `action=double_tap`, `action=long_press`, `action_type=input_text`, and `action=drag_and_drop`. Optional for `action=swipe`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "coordinate2": {
                    "description": "(x, y): The end coordinates for `drag_and_drop`. Required only by `drag_and_drop`.",
                    "type": "array"
                },
                "direction": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used for action_type=scroll or action_type=swipe.",
                    "enum": [
                        "up",
                        "down",
                        "left",
                        "right"
                    ]
                },
                "app_name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Used only when action_type=open_app."
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "action_type"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
        }
    }
}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>
